# /rem:task (Antigravity port)

This skill is the `/rem:task` slash command of the `rem` plugin. Antigravity plugins have
no slash commands, so perform the command below yourself:

- **Arguments**: `$ARGUMENTS` stands for whatever the user wrote after the command (expected: `open <slug> "<goal>" [--scope <paths>] [--owner <who>] | close <slug> ["<reason>"] [--journal-only D<n>,...]`). Ask if it is missing and required.
- **Plugin root**: `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` is this plugin's directory — two levels above this SKILL.md.
- **Inline shell**: a line of the form !`<command>` is a shell command — run it with `run_command`
  (arguments and plugin root substituted) and treat its output as if it stood in its place.
- **Subagents**: where the command dispatches an agent or the Task tool, use `invoke_subagent`;
  this plugin's agents are loaded from its `agents/` directory.
- **User-only**: in Claude Code only the user may run this command. Run it only when the user explicitly asked for /rem:task in this turn — never on your own initiative.

---

!`node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/task.js" $ARGUMENTS`

Show the user the output above verbatim. Do not run `task.js open` or `task.js close` yourself:
without this command's authority record it is refused, and a workaround is detected by
scope-validate. Every other verb: `task.js help`; the mechanism: `skills/rem/reference/tasks.md`.
